# Referral Program Design

`referral-program-design` · v1.0.0 · Design · Growth, Retention & RevOps
<!-- Generated by platform/scripts/generate-engine-specs.mjs from skills/referral-program-design/spec.json and SKILL.md. Do not edit. -->

**Decision it supports:** Would a referral program bring in customers more cheaply than the channel it replaces, and what is the most we can pay in rewards?

**Inputs:** Active customer count, the signals that mark an engaged customer (NPS, usage, renewals), your own or assumed ask and conversion rates, reward cost per side, LTV, and the CAC of the channel referral would replace

**Output:** A referral program design (who, when, reward, mechanics, tracking) with referral CAC, break-even reward, payback, LTV:CAC, k-factor, findings, and compliance pointers to check with counsel

**Setup:**
- Install the skill: `npx skills add sarojkjha/aaj-marketing-skills --skill referral-program-design`
- Or connect the hosted MCP server, no install: `https://aaj-engines-mcp.sarojkjha10.workers.dev/mcp`
- Or run the local MCP server: node platform/mcp/server.mjs (Node 18 or newer)
- Input schema: the comment at the top of `skills/referral-program-design/resources/referral-economics.js` (the MCP server's describe_engine shows it). Worked example: `node skills/referral-program-design/resources/referral-economics.js --demo`.
- Agents listed: Claude Code, Cursor, OpenAI Codex, Windsurf, Cline. Tested and recorded: not recorded yet.

**Acts or analyzes:** Analyzes only. The engine makes no network calls, writes no files and changes nothing in your tools; it returns text and JSON.

**Where your information goes:**

| How you run it | Where your inputs go |
|---|---|
| Skill installed in your agent, or the local MCP server | The engine runs on your machine and AAJ receives nothing. Your AI agent still sends what you give it to its model provider (Anthropic, OpenAI and so on), under your own account's terms. |
| Hosted MCP server | Your agent's model provider, as above, plus AAJ's server on Cloudflare, which receives the engine inputs over HTTPS, runs them in memory and keeps no copy. Cloudflare keeps error logs (no inputs) for up to 7 days. |

No engine needs customer names, emails or other personal data; leave them out.

**Limitations:**
- Ask and conversion rates are usually guesses before launch. With assumed inputs the output is a scenario; replace them with measured rates after the first period.
- It models one period. The amplification figure assumes referred customers refer at the same rate as others, which is unmeasured until they do.
- Referred customers get the same LTV unless you pass a measured referredLtv. Do not assume they are worth more; the 16% finding is from one bank.
- Compliance flags print pointers to rules (FTC, Anti-Kickback, HIPAA); they are not a legal check. The research is mostly consumer, with no peer-reviewed B2B cash-reward study.

**Review before acting:** The founder or finance lead confirms LTV, the CAC being replaced and which rates are assumptions. Counsel reviews any reward involving public posts, reviews or healthcare providers before launch.
